meaning: One new strict-FP helper and original-scalar reference driver. Existing private tag word adds exact zero/one/minus-one/nonzero-valid facts and complete bit, with original identity-only stores; complete writes refresh, partial writes clear. Unknown or legacy-normalization-only metadata recomputes facts. All nonidentity expressions/order are extracted from exact AK fast bodies; full fallback and original identity precedence/valid bits/signed zeros remain. All555660calls/66679200bank/13335840metadata words must match original scalar and independent float-equality/std::nextafter expectations. No raw/host/shader compilation or performance/scientific/release claim.
